text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem - we need a compact safety playbook for rollouts. Goal: reduce blast radius and enable a fast, auditable stop.
sam: I'll prototype an "auto-rollback" controller with a dry-run mode (suggest only) first. Target: draft PR by next Tue.
li: I'll own per-flag scope caps (user/host/percent) and a migration plan for long-lived flags. Suggest default caps: 2% or 200 users, whichever smaller.
ryan: Observability: I'll add "preflight" signals + a tiny dashboard tile that shows suggested rollback reasons. Proposed triggers: 5xx spike >0.4% for 3m, p95 >2.5x baseline for 5m, cross-tenant error concentration.
tess: I'll build lightweight pre-ramp probes (preflight smoke) that run critical flows against the canary at 5% and block ramp if failures >0.
security-team: Kill-switch must be stored in Vault with an ACL role rollout_kill and an emergency two-person veto. All kills audited.
marta: Action list recap (confirm): sam -> auto-rollback dry-run PR by 2026-04-05; li -> scope caps + migration doc by 2026-04-02; ryan -> dashboard & alert rules by 2026-04-06; tess -> preflight probe harness & test matrix by 2026-04-04; security-team -> vault kill-switch policy by 2026-04-03.
sam: I'll include a simulation log index so we can measure false positives before enforcing.
li: Will add flag metadata for owner, lifetime, scope caps.
marta: I'll create the umbrella ticket and link to the postmortem. Sync Thurs 11:00 to hand over and lock commitments. React :thumbsup: when you accept.
ryan: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
li: :thumbsup:
